blocks.html: Veksha S1 is a compact professional handheld 3D scanner designed to make high-accuracy 3D scanning accessible for education, product design, engineering, digital archiving, reverse engineering, and creative applications.

Key Features

High-Precision 3D Scanning

Advanced blue light structured scanning technology delivers scanning accuracy up to 0.03 mm.

24-Bit Full Color Capture

Integrated 24-bit color camera enables realistic color texture capture with true-to-life visual reproduction.
AI Visual Tracking
AI-powered visual tracking enables smooth and stable scanning without the need for markers.

Marker-Free Scanning

Efficient marker-free operation simplifies workflows and improves scanning convenience.

Anti-Shake Optical System

Integrated optical anti-shake modules improve scanning stability and help users capture complex objects more effectively.

High-Resolution Detail Capture

Detailed point cloud generation preserves fine surface details and geometry.

Smart AI Processing

AI-powered software tools automatically improve scan quality and reduce errors.

Automatic Alignment

Automatic scan alignment simplifies multi-angle scanning and improves workflow efficiency.

Portable Lightweight Design

Compact handheld architecture makes the scanner easy to transport and deploy in classrooms, studios, labs, and industrial environments.

Wide Object Size Compatibility

Supports scanning objects ranging from small components to larger objects up to 1500 mm.
